name: DocOcrMax

parameters.help_en: The product solution to be integrated. Valid value: ID_OCR_MAX
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案。

取值ID_OCR_MAX
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom authentication scene ID, which is used to query related records by entering this scene ID in the console later. The value can be up to 10 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录。

支持长度为10位的字母、数字和下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The custom unique business identifier, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues later. The value can be up to 32 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. Make sure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题。

支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID or other identifiers that can identify a specific user, such as a mobile phone number or an email address. Desensitize the value of this field in advance, such as by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。

强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image of the identity document. If you choose to pass the identity document image by using the IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded image) method, check the image size and do not pass an excessively large image
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片Base64编码。

如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入证件照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the identity document image. The URL must be an HTTP or HTTPS link that is accessible over the Internet
parameters.help_zh: 卡证图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The OCR recognition mode. Valid values:
0: general identity document recognition mode (default)
1: automatic identity document classification mode
2: automatic identity document classification and general recognition mode
parameters.help_zh:
OCR识别模式：

0：通用证件识别模式（默认）

1：证件自动分类模式

2：证件自动分类+通用识别模式
parameters.name: ocr_model

parameters.help_en:
The type of the identity document.
Format: country code + identity document type abbreviation + page (optional).

Note
OcrModel = 0: DocType is required and specifies the identity document type. The existing logic remains unchanged.
OcrModel = 1 or 2: DocType must be left empty
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型。
格式：国家（地区）代码+证件类型缩写+页面（可选）

说明
OcrModel = 0：DocType必传，指定证件类型，现有逻辑不变
OcrModel = 1或2：DocType需要为空
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality check threshold mode. Valid values:
0: system default
1: strict mode
2: loose mode
3: disable quality check (default)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义OCR质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the identity document anti-spoofing feature. Valid values:
T: Enabled.
F: Not enabled (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启证件防伪功能：

T：开启

F（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: id_spoof

parameters.help_en:
The page to be recognized. Valid values:
01: portrait side of the identity document (default)
02: back side of the identity document
parameters.help_zh:
期望识别的页面

01（默认）：证件人像面

02：证件背面
parameters.name: doc_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the standardization of key fields in OCR recognition. Valid values:
0: no (default) 
1: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要开启OCR识别关键字段标准化
0：否 (默认) 
1：是
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable authoritative data source verification to enhance the anti-spoofing capability of identity documents. Valid values:
T: Enabled.
F: Not enabled (default).

Applicable identity document types: Chinese resident identity card (CHN01001) and Chinese mainland driver's license (CHN02001).
Data transmission statement: Enabling this parameter indicates that you agree to transmit the user's name and identity document number to an authoritative data source in the Chinese mainland for consistency verification.
Performance impact: After this parameter is enabled, the API response time increases by about 1 to 2 seconds. Adjust the timeout settings accordingly
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用权威数据源核验以增强证件防伪能力。

T：启用

F：不启用（默认值）


适用证件类型：中国居民身份证（CHN01001）、中国内地驾驶证（CHN02001）。
数据传输声明：启用此参数，即表示同意将用户的姓名和证件号码传输至中国内地权威数据源进行一致性校验。
性能影响：启用后，接口响应时间将增加约 1-2 秒。建议调整超时时间设置
parameters.name: authorize

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The identity document recognition result. This parameter is returned only when the API responds successfully
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:
Y: Passed.
N: Not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过。

Y：通过。
N：不通过
